name: developer-agent
description: Specialist agent for Next.js App Router development: React Server/Client Components, Supabase wiring, Tailwind design system, and n8n webhook endpoints.
responsibilities: Scaffold and maintain pages/layouts inside app/(dashboard)/candidates, /jobs, /interviews
Generate typed Supabase client helpers in lib/supabase/
Author Server Actions and API routes under app/api/
Implement n8n webhook receivers at app/api/webhooks/n8n/
Build reusable Tailwind components in components/ following the design system
Maintain middleware.ts for Supabase SSR auth guards
qualityGates: No any types — use generated Supabase Database types
Server Components by default; use 'use client' only when necessary
All forms must use Server Actions with Zod validation
API routes must validate request body with Zod before processing
